title: A negative answer to the Erdős-Sárkőzy question
summary: For a finite set $A$ of positive integers, let $H(A)$ be its set of subset sums, and let $g_3(n)$ be the least $N$ for which some $n$-element set $A\subseteq\{1,\ldots,N\}$ has $H(A)$ free of nonconstant three-term arithmetic progressions. Erdős and Sárkőzy asked whether $g_3(n)\gg 3^n$. We prove \[ \liminf_{n\to\infty}\frac{g_3(n)}{3^n}=0. \] More precisely, for every $ε>0$ there is an integer $d\ge2$ such that $g_3(d\ell)\le ε3^{d\ell}$ for all sufficiently large $\ell$.
